label: Chat Message
description: Append one message to a conversation file (`historyFile`), in place: the same file LLM nodes read and add their turns to, so a conversation is built by chaining this node and LLM calls on one file. With no file in, it starts a new conversation file, kept past the run. For a tool result in an agent's tool loop: `role: "tool"`, the result on `text`, the call's `id` on `toolCallId`, the loop's carried file on `historyFile`; this node's `historyFile` output is the loop's next carry.

inputs.name: historyFile
inputs.description: The conversation so far (an LLM node's or another Chat Message's `historyFile` output, or a stored file holding `[]`). The message is added to this file in place. Unwired, a new conversation file is started.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Media attached to this message: one stored image, audio clip, or video, or a list of them.

inputs.name: toolCallId
inputs.description: For role 'tool' only: the id of the tool call this message answers (from an LLM node's toolCalls output).

inputs.name: cacheBreakpoint
inputs.label: Cache up to here
inputs.description: Prompt-cache everything up to and including this message. Any mark in a conversation turns the LLM node's automatic marks off.

outputs.name: historyFile
outputs.description: The file that came in (next version), or the new one this message started.

then.message: ChatHistoryAppend '{id}' is a tool message with no `toolCallId`. Wire the id of the tool call it answers (an LLM node's toolCalls output) to `toolCallId`.
ChatHistoryAppend '{id}' has a `toolCallId` but is not a tool message. Set `role` to tool, or remove `toolCallId`.
